items.html: *When the mochin of Aba and Ima enter ZA, behold Aba has Hochma and Bina and Hesed and Gevura, and corresponding to them in Ima. And when they enter ZA, then the Hochma and Hesed of Aba combine with the Hochma and Hesed of Ima, clothed in his NNH; and his Bina and Gevura combine with the Bina and Gevura of Ima, in her NNH. And then Aba and Ima are included of MaH and BaN.
